lane_title: Cross-Gradient Orthogonal Conduit Extraction (gravity × magnetic intersections weighted by dilation)
hypothesis: Orthogonal intersections where Basin-and-Range normal faults are cross-cut by Walker Lane transfer faults produce cross-gradient discordance between isostatic gravity and reduced-to-pole magnetic gradients (|sin Δθ| → 1) co-located with extensional dilational strain; these intersections host fracture-permeability sweet spots missed by air-photo catalogue mappers because surface expression is a broad alluvial fan confluence, not a sharp scarp.
mechanism: Normalized cross-gradient |G_grav × G_mag|/(|G_grav||G_mag|+ε) = |sinΔθ| between gravity (iso_grav_anom_hg/vg) and magnetic (tmi_hg/tmi_vg) gradients, weighted by basement high-pass relief (|depth_to_base_surf - G25(depth)|), gravity slope ridge magnitude, dilatational strain gate (geod_dilaterate >0) and shear modulation, emitted via 3px catalogue collar and 2.83px Dinkelbach-style spacing to maximize expected pooled DTI under 300m triangular kernel.
named_non_fault_mimic: Circular Mesozoic granitic pluton margins and Tertiary caldera ring faults (suppressed via high-pass basement relief and requiring geod_dilaterate >0; static contacts lack extensional strain).

preregistration.lane_title: Cross-Gradient Orthogonal Conduit Extraction (gravity × magnetic intersections weighted by dilation)
preregistration.hypothesis: Orthogonal intersections where Basin-and-Range normal faults are cross-cut by Walker Lane transfer faults produce cross-gradient discordance between isostatic gravity and reduced-to-pole magnetic gradients (|sin Δθ| → 1) co-located with extensional dilational strain; these intersections host fracture-permeability sweet spots missed by air-photo catalogue mappers because surface expression is a broad alluvial fan confluence, not a sharp scarp.
preregistration.mechanism: Compute normalized cross-gradient between gravity (iso_grav_anom_hg/vg) and magnetic (tmi_hg/tmi_vg) gradient vectors: |G_grav × G_mag|/(|G_grav||G_mag|+ε) = |sinΔθ|. Weight by dilatational strain (geod_dilaterate) and basement-step ridge magnitude (iso_grav_anom_slope) with high-pass depth_to_base_surf to suppress pluton rims. Emit dots via probability-weighted sampling with 3-px catalogue collar and 2.8-px inter-dot spacing to maximize expected pooled DTI under 300m triangular kernel.
preregistration.named_non_fault_mimic: Circular Mesozoic granitic pluton margins and Tertiary caldera ring faults (suppressed via high-pass basement relief and requiring geod_dilaterate > 0; static lithologic contacts lack extensional strain).
